entry.title: School Committee: agenda posted for the meeting of 25 September 2026
entry.summary: The town posted the agenda for the School Committee meeting of 25 September 2026. The agenda itself: https://www.lunenburgma.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_09252026-8038

entry.title: School Committee: the meeting of 16 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Paraprofessional contract vote delayed again over salary-calculation errors; two placeholder warrant articles advanced. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XY8Ru12S9Xg), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.

entry.title: School Committee: the meeting of 9 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: The school committee will hire its own next business administrator, deciding by vote next week after tonight's public interview. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tKWYbMFWJtI), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.

entry.title: School Committee: the meeting of 26 August 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: The committee voted to restore a second-grade teacher and literacy funding over an audit or a second BCBA. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J_kvfs3s0UE), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.

entry.title: School Committee: the meeting of 29 July 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: The school committee voted to submit its own warrant article demanding the full extra state aid for the September 3rd special town meeting. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wR4gBkOqIaE), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
